Here are some **clothing stores and boutiques in Nashville, Tennessee** where you can shop for high-end, stylish pieces — including a **dark burgundy professional blazer** or other photo-shoot worthy outfits. Nashville has both *boutique-only shops* and *larger retailers* with elevated fashion options. citeturn0search0turn0search1

### ⭐️ Upscale & Trend-Forward Boutiques (Great for Photo Shoot Looks)

**Boutiques with curated, fashion-forward collections** — perfect for that professional yet sexy, high-end look:

- **entity["turn0business1","Hollie Ray Boutique",1]** – Highly-rated women’s fashion boutique with elevated apparel and accessories — great for shoots.  
- **entity["turn0business9","Blush Boutique",1]** – Trendy curated clothing with a chic vibe.  
- **entity["turn0business2","The Mill Boutique",0]** – Stylish women’s clothing and accessories in Green Hills.  
- **entity["turn0business11","Elle Gray Boutique",0]** – Boutique offering modern, timeless pieces.  
- **entity["turn0business13","The Shop at W Nashville",0]** – Boutique with elevated apparel in a luxury setting.  
- **entity["turn0business21","Molly Green - Hillsboro Village",0]** – Chic and playful pieces that can photograph beautifully.  
- **entity["turn0business17","ABEDNEGO",0]** – Stylish boutique with curated clothing for a bold look.

Additional boutiques with unique, local fashion you might explore for *unique photo shoot tops, dresses & accessories*:  
- **entity["turn0business3","Vinnie Louise",0]** – Boutique with stylish clothing and accessories.  
- **entity["turn0business7","Pauli's Place Boutique",0]** – Well-liked local boutique.  
- **entity["turn0business15","nancybgoods",0]** – Stylish boutique with well-curated selections.  
- **entity["turn0business16","Najib Boutique",0]** – Another local option to browse.  
- **entity["turn0business8","Ari and Ava",0]** – Inclusive boutique with fashion-forward pieces (sizes up to 5XL).

👉 Many boutiques in Nashville’s **12 South and Green Hills neighborhoods** are known for fashion-forward, shoot-ready pieces. citeturn0search0

### 🛍️ Larger & Brand Stores (With Classic & Elevated Options)

- **entity["turn0business14","Anthropologie",1]** – Great for elevated blazers, dresses, statement pieces, and accessories.  
- **entity["turn0business10","Zara",0]** – If you want brand pieces similar to Aritzia’s vibe (note: reviews vary, but still carries many professional outfits).  
- **Green Hills Mall (not a store but nearby)** – Houses stores like **Nordstrom, Madewell, J.Crew, Free People, Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Tory Burch** and more for premium styles. citeturn0search6

### 💡 Insider Tip for Your Shoot  
- **Visit the *Mall at Green Hills*** first — it’s Nashville’s premier shopping destination with a mix of **elevated brands and boutiques under one roof**. citeturn0search6  
- After that, explore **12 South boutiques** for unique, fashion-forward finds that photograph beautifully. citeturn0search1

If you want, I can recommend **specific pieces (like suits, blazers, dresses)** in these stores or online right now — just tell me your **budget** and **desired vibe** (e.g., edgy, classic, sexy professional)!

attributes.about_this_biz_bio: Hi, I’m Callie Richards—also known as @hotpinkandglitter on social media. After years of working in retail and sharing plus-size style online, I realized how many women—myself included—felt overlooked by traditional brands. I started Ari and Ava in July 2024 to create the kind of shopping experience I always wished existed: inclusive, welcoming, and full of styles that actually fit and inspire joy. Our boutique in Nashville and online store offer curated fashion in sizes 0XL to 5XL, with a focus on comfort, confidence, and community. Whether you're shopping in person or from afar, my goal is to help every customer feel celebrated.
attributes.about_this_biz_history: As a plus-size woman, I constantly felt—like so many of my friends—that we were an afterthought in the fashion world. We were tired of limited options, inconsistent sizing, and the feeling that style wasn’t made for us. I started Ari and Ava to change that. I wanted to create a space, both in-person and online, where plus-size shoppers could feel seen, celebrated, and truly excited to shop. From personalized service to thoughtfully chosen pieces in sizes 0XL to 5XL, everything we do is designed with the plus-size experience in mind. We opened our doors in July 2024, and we’re proud to be building a boutique community that puts inclusion, style, and joy at the center.
attributes.about_this_biz_specialties: Ari and Ava is a plus-size women’s boutique based in Nashville, TN, offering stylish, high-quality clothing in sizes 0XL to 5XL. We specialize in curating fashion-forward, body-inclusive pieces that celebrate confidence, comfort, and individuality. From everyday essentials to standout statement looks, our collections are designed to help plus-size women feel seen, celebrated, and truly at home while shopping. Whether you visit us in-store or online, you'll find personalized styling, a warm and welcoming team, and a boutique experience that puts your joy first.
